source: Power BI Desktop live answers via tools/m_oracle_diff.py, 2026-11-09 (Task 103 probes: Decimal-typed results of Abs / Int64.From / Number.From, Number.FromText forms (percent, currency, parentheses, signs, de-DE), Number.ToText standard formats X D G E F N P C R and custom formats, Sin/Cos/Tan beyond 2**30 and 2**63, Tanh/Sinh/Cosh at large arguments, Power with integer exponents and near 1, Log with integer results).
